styleGuide: Use casual, friendly tone with だ/である体 for narration, but polite です/ます体 for direct address to viewer.
Keep sentence endings consistent: use んだ/のだ for explanatory tone, よ for emphasis.
Translate technical terms consistently using the glossary; avoid English loanwords where natural Japanese exists.
For humor, use colloquial expressions like やばい, マジで, すごい.
Keep subtitle length short; break long sentences into multiple subtitles.
Use ～てる/～てる form for progressive actions (e.g., やってる instead of やっている).
For emphasis, use 本当に, めっちゃ, 超.
When quoting someone, use って言う/言ってた.
Avoid overly literal translations; prefer natural phrasing like ～ってこと for explanatory clauses.
For numbers, use Arabic numerals in subtitles for readability.
